name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Turn off iMessage sending and the connection notification.
Show iMessage automatic renewal and relay status.
Pair with imsg-server using a one-time code.
Optional iMessage through your own bridge server.
Use the Sonim Messaging and Music icons and restore AppDrawer artwork [skip ci].
Mods: stock-signed builds for Messages, Launcher and Music; remove OEM signing.
Splice dex into the stock APKs for test deploys.
Verify renamed Messages hook targets in release builds.
